summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a $125M private placement of 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes due 2031, issued at par with an initial conversion price of ~$25.48/share, convertible into 39.2425 ordinary shares per $1,000 principal. The offering closed on July 17, 2026, netting ~$120.1M after fees. No tender offer, acquisition, or special-situation event is present; this is a routine capital-raising transaction by the issuer with standard registration rights. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category under the classification guidelines.
